description: `<tp-spreadsheet-editor>` provides an editable grid with Excel-style formulas.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: CSV, JSON or XLSX file URL loaded on connection and whenever it changes.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: JSON-encoded two-dimensional array of raw cell values.

methods.name: deleteColumn(): void
methods.description: Deletes the active column, adjusts selection, clears cell formatting and emits a structure-change event. Preserves the last remaining column.

methods.name: deleteRow(): void
methods.description: Deletes the active row, adjusts selection, clears cell formatting and emits a structure-change event. Preserves the last remaining row.

methods.name: exportFile(format: TpSpreadsheetFileFormat, filename = "spreadsheet", mode: TpSpreadsheetExportMode = "formulas"): void
methods.description: Downloads CSV, JSON or XLSX using filename plus the extension. The formulas mode preserves raw formulas; values exports calculated cell results.

methods.name: getData(): string[][]
methods.description: Returns a row-by-row copy of raw cell strings, including formulas rather than calculated results.

methods.name: importFile(file: File): Promise<void>
methods.description: Loads CSV, JSON or the first XLSX sheet into the editor, records undo state and emits tp-spreadsheet-editor-import. Resolves after application; unsupported or invalid files reject.

methods.name: insertColumn(position: "before" | "after" = "after"): void
methods.description: Inserts an empty column before or after the active cell, selects it, clears cell formatting and emits a structure-change event. Does nothing without a valid active cell.

methods.name: insertRow(position: "before" | "after" = "after"): void
methods.description: Inserts an empty row before or after the active cell, selects it, clears cell formatting and emits a structure-change event. Does nothing without a valid active cell.

methods.name: setData(value: readonly (readonly unknown[])[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the matrix, converts values to strings and pads missing cells with empty strings. Updates rows, columns and value, retaining at least one row and column.

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-clipboard-error
events.description: Emitted when a clipboard command fails; command identifies copy, cut or paste.

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-error
events.description: Emitted when fetching or parsing src fails, except for aborted requests; src is the requested URL and error is the caught failure.

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-export
events.description: Emitted after a CSV, JSON or XLSX download is prepared; filename includes the extension.

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-import
events.description: Emitted after an imported file replaces the sheet; format is the detected filename extension and file is the selected File object.

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-input
events.description: Emitted for each edited or cleared cell. cell is its A1 reference, raw is the stored input or formula, and value is the evaluated result.
events.detail: { cell: string; raw: string; value: string | number | boolean | Date }

events.name: tp-spreadsheet-editor-structure
events.description: Emitted after inserting or deleting a row or column. index is zero-based; rows and columns are the resulting dimensions.
events.detail: { action: "insert-row" | "delete-row" | "insert-column" | "delete-column"; index: number; rows: number; columns: number }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-spreadsheet-editor>` element provides an editable spreadsheet with Excel-style formulas, file import and export, cell selection and resizable columns.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click a cell | Select the active cell and edit its content. The formula bar displays its raw value or formula. |
| Shift + click a cell | Select the rectangle from the selection anchor to the clicked cell. A plain click starts a new selection. |
| Clear selected cells | Clear selected values and formulas while preserving formatting. Undo restores the operation in one step. |
| Drag the right edge of a column heading | Resize the column, with a minimum of 48 pixels and no upper limit. Wide sheets scroll horizontally; widths survive cell edits and formatting changes. |
| Double-click a column resize handle | Restore the default width of 112 pixels. |
| File → Import | Load a CSV, JSON or XLSX file. |
| File → Export CSV / JSON / XLSX — formulas | Save the sheet with its raw formulas. |
| File → Export CSV / JSON / XLSX — values | Save calculated results without changing formulas in the open sheet. |
| Formula picker | Choose a function and replace the selected parameters in the formula bar. |
| Format | Set General, Number, Currency, Percent or Date display for the active cell. |
| Cell style | Toggle Bold, Italic, Underline or Strikethrough for the active cell. |
| Clear formatting | Remove number and text formatting from the active cell. |
| Table | Insert a row or column before or after the active cell, or delete its row or column. At least one row and column remain. |
| Undo / Redo | Undo or redo cell edits, grouped clearing and structural changes. |
| Copy / Cut / Paste | Use the system clipboard with the active cell. Copying shifts relative formula references when pasted; cutting preserves the formula. These actions operate on one cell, even when a range is selected. |
| Search / Close search | Highlight matching cells, or clear the search and hide its field. |
| Fullscreen | Toggle fullscreen for this spreadsheet. |
| Color / Theme | Change the spreadsheet's local brand color or theme. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Left</kbd> / <kbd>Right</kbd> on a focused column resize handle | Decrease / increase column width by 8 pixels. Reach handles with <kbd>Tab</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> / <kbd>X</kbd> / <kbd>V</kbd> in a cell | Copy, cut or paste the active cell. Copying shifts relative formula references when pasted; cutting preserves them. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> | Extend or shrink the rectangular selection. |
| <kbd>Delete</kbd> / <kbd>Backspace</kbd> with multiple cells selected | Clear the selected cells in one undoable operation. With one cell selected, edit its text normally. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Collapse the selection to the focused cell. |
| Typing in a selected cell | Edit its value or enter a formula beginning with =. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
